depositCollateralAndMintAUSD(address,uin.details: Must maintain a health factor >= 1 after execution and must not exceed debt ceilings for any collateral type.

forceClose(address).details: The position must either have collateral <= $100 or health factor <= 0.50 to be eligible.

liquidate(address,address,uint256).details: The caller receives the debt they covered plus a 5% bonus in collateral, and the protocol takes a 5% fee.

mintAUSD(uint256).details: Must not break the user health factor and must not exceed debt ceilings for any collateral type.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

redeemCollateral(address,uint256).details: Must maintain a health factor >= 1 after redemption.

redeemCollateralAndBurnAUSD(address,uint.details: Must maintain a health factor >= 1 after execution.

redeemCollateralWithSlippage(address,uin.details: In volatile markets, this protects the user from burning more AUSD than they expected. If no burn is needed, zero AUSD is burned.

returns._0: The actual amount of AUSD burned in the process.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

burnAUSD(uint256).notice: Burn `amount` AUSD and reduce the caller’s debt proportionally.

canPause().notice: Returns whether a protocol meets the pause condition (collateralization ratio < 1.10)

checkUpkeep(bytes).notice: Chainlink Automation compatible function to check if index or LTV updates are needed. Returns encoded booleans indicating which updates are needed.

depositCollateralAndMintAUSD(address,uin.notice: Deposit `amountCollateral` of `collateralToken` and mint `amountAUSDToMint` AUSD in one transaction.

forceClose(address).notice: Forcefully close an underwater position by seizing all remaining collateral and clearing the user's debt using treasury funds.

getCollateralInfo(address).notice: Full collateral token info snapshot: price feed, LTV, debt ceiling, total normalized debt, and active flag.

getCollateralList().notice: Returns the list of supported collateral tokens.

getGlobalMetrics().notice: Returns the protocol's total collateral value in USD and total actual debt.

getLiquidationProfit(address,address,uin.notice: Returns the liquidation profit for a given user and debtToCover (reverts if user is healthy).

getTokenAmountFromUsd(address,uint256).notice: Returns the amount of collateral tokens for a given USD value.

getUsdValue(address,uint256).notice: Returns the USD value for a given amount of collateral tokens.

getUserAccountData(address).notice: Full user snapshot: active collaterals, amounts, debt allocations, total debt, collateral, HF, and last index.

getUserDebtAllocation(address,address).notice: Returns the user's debt allocation for the specified `collateralToken`

liquidate(address,address,uint256).notice: Liquidate an underwater position, seizing up to the dynamic close factor of the debt.

mintAUSD(uint256).notice: Mint `amountAUSDToMint` AUSD using the caller’s deposited collateral.

pause().notice: Pause all state-changing operations. Only callable by the owner when the protocol's collateralization ratio falls below 110%.

performUpkeep(bytes).notice: Updates the cumulative index and/or LTVs if their respective update intervals have passed.

redeemCollateralAndBurnAUSD(address,uint.notice: Burn `amountAUSDToBurn` AUSD and redeem `amountCollateral` of `collateralToken` in one transaction.

redeemCollateralWithSlippage(address,uin.notice: Redeem a fixed amount of collateral, burning only as much AUSD as necessary (up to `maxAUSDToBurn`) to stay healthy.

setCollateralInfo(address,address,uint25.notice: Update volatility feed, LTV, debt ceiling, and active status for a collateral token. Pass 0 or address(0) to leave a value unchanged.

setForwarderAddress(address).notice: Set the Chainlink Automation Sepolia forwarder address.

unpause().notice: Unpause the protocol. Only callable by the owner.
